purpose: Request and return bounded condition-sensitive reachability analysis without placing source truth or deployment truth in the authored input.

compatibility.wirePlan: source-authorization-assessment-wire/v3 extends v2 only when a condition request is present; v1 and v2 remain unchanged
compatibility.noRequestBehavior: A task without the optional request uses the existing result and coverage path and must not invent condition branches.

requestContract.identityRule: The sidecar adds explicit IDs because v0 task conditions have names but no IDs. A binding resolves by exact name within one authored obligation; array position is never identity.
requestContract.compilationRule: One valid authored request is expanded only to that authored obligation's runnable expanded obligations. The compiled condition definition carries the existing authored name and basis; the request never supplies an effect.
diagnostics: duplicate condition names within the requested authored obligation
binding to an unknown authored condition name
duplicate request for one authored obligation
forbiddenPrefill: observed true or false condition value
oracle facts or evaluator scoring criteria
deployment truth inferred from source capability

factPointers: canonical result fact pointer from the same obligation
missingFacts: decisive fact absent from fixed context

unexaminedConditionIds: requested condition ID not analyzed in any branch

resultContract.boundedMeaning: Every requested condition is considered in at least one returned assumption and none is listed unexamined. Bounded does not mean an exhaustive truth table or complete program-path enumeration.
resultContract.incompleteMeaning: Every requested condition not considered in a branch is listed exactly once in unexaminedConditionIds and limitations explains the bound or missing evidence.
resultContract.unknownRule: An unknown effect or an unknown-valued assumption requires at least one decisive missing fact. A reachable or blocked claim requires at least one same-obligation fact pointer.
resultContract.branchIdentityRule: A branch may assign each condition at most once. Identical normalized assumption sets may not be repeated; two different effects must be distinguished by different assumptions.
resultContract.hostBoundary: The host validates schema, IDs, obligation mapping, assignment consistency, branch bound, explicit omissions, missing-fact requirements, and same-obligation fact pointers. It never derives reachability or upgrades semantic support from a pointer.

publicCompletionRequirements: Explain how each requested condition can change whether the protected effect is reachable, or list it as explicitly unexamined.
Keep analysis assumptions separate from source-observed or deployment-observed facts.
Use a concrete unknown with decisive missing facts when fixed source context cannot decide an external condition.
Cite same-obligation facts for reachable or blocked effects and do not treat a citation as proof of semantic correctness.
Respect maxBranches without generating an exponential truth table.

publicWalkthroughs.authoredObligation: Assess whether a caller may modify a resource under the accepted owner-or-privileged-role policy.

authoredConditions.name: caller owns resource
authoredConditions.basis: The accepted policy names ownership as one authorization relation.

authoredConditions.name: caller has privileged role
authoredConditions.basis: The accepted policy names an explicit role override.

publicWalkthroughs.publicQuestion: Explain how ownership and the role override alter effect reachability, including any branch the fixed source cannot decide.

publicWalkthroughs.authoredObligation: Assess whether a protected entry can reach its effect when a declared configuration gate controls the path.

authoredConditions.name: feature gate enabled
authoredConditions.basis: The task declares the configuration gate as relevant but does not state its runtime value.

publicWalkthroughs.publicQuestion: Describe the enabled, disabled, and unresolved gate cases using source evidence and explicit missing facts.

publicWalkthroughs.authoredObligation: Assess whether an external caller-controlled identity assertion can reach a protected operation through a configured agent boundary.

authoredConditions.name: external agent validates identity assertion
authoredConditions.basis: The source assumes an upstream assertion, while deployment validation behavior is outside the fixed source context.

publicWalkthroughs.publicQuestion: Separate source-visible capability from the unknown deployed agent behavior and name the minimum observation needed to decide it.

author: provide accepted policy, explicit obligation, authored condition name and basis
opt in by binding stable condition IDs and a branch bound
compiler: resolve exact names and authored-to-expanded obligation mapping
emit only structural plans and diagnostics
model: derive condition assumptions, effects, explanations, source facts, and missing facts from the fixed context
host: perform mechanical validation and at most the existing diagnostics-only repair
evaluator: judge decision semantics, condition explanation completeness, unsupported claims, and equivalently expressed branches
